_about: The 2025 prize winners exactly as the RS57 sheet records them. Hand-transcribed ground
truth, the acceptance target for Phase 2.
Prize money is league-specific and appears nowhere in ESPN, so the sheet is the ONLY
source for who won what. There is no second witness. That is the whole reason this file
is transcribed rather than generated: a fixture generated from the engine would agree
with the engine no matter how wrong the engine was.
If a case here disagrees with the engine, that is a bug or an undocumented rule. Chase it
down; do not adjust the fixture.
_identity: The sheet names winners by FIRST NAME. This repo and the site it generates are PUBLIC,
so no real name is recorded here — every winner is an espn_team_id, which is what the
The first-name -> espn_team_id mapping used to transcribe this was read from ESPN's own
public league endpoint (members[].firstName joined through teams[].owners), NOT from a
private file. data/private/ is deferred by decision and was not created. The mapping was
used once, in session, to check these winners against the sheet; it is deliberately not
stored anywhere in the repo. Anyone re-verifying can re-read it from ESPN in a minute.
franchise_name is carried alongside the id purely so the commissioner can eyeball this
table against the sheet. Team names change every season and must never be keyed on.
